name: Wat Phra That Choeng Chum
scope: The white masonry Phra That Choeng Chum stupa with its gilt spire and the adjoining four-gabled viharn immediately east.
era: Standing form of the stupa and adjacent prayer hall in the source photograph and the Thai heritage agency description.

originalReview.notes: Exact Qualla own-work original with explicit dedication. Shows the white steps and portal of the stupa alongside the glazed orange and green roofs and three doors of the neighboring hall.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: The exact cleared Mattes original is used for the stupa and Naga-edged roof shapes and material colors. Architectural dimensions and placement use the named native survey and Thai government text.
